en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a rainy, stormy view of a European city with a river, bridge, church towers, and a hilltop fortress or castle above the town. Lightning, heavy rain, and people in the streets are depicted. Inset at the lower right is a circular vignette of people being blown about by the wind. The lower margin contains printed German text in a decorative typeface, and there is handwritten German script across the bottom and right edge. The main printed caption reads "Grüsse aus Graz."
